title: Creation
introduction: Creation is the Bible's opening theme and the foundation of the entire biblical worldview. God creates the world out of nothing, with order and purpose. Humanity is created in God's image as the climax of creation, entrusted with stewardship over the earth.

sections.title: In the Beginning
sections.description: The first words of the Bible affirm that God is the source of all that exists.

sections.title: Humanity Created in God's Image
sections.description: Humanity is unique within creation—made in God's image with dignity and responsibility.

sections.title: Creation Testifies to God
sections.description: The created world reveals God's greatness and power to all people.

sections.title: Christ as Creator
sections.description: The New Testament reveals that Jesus Christ was actively involved in creation.

sections.title: The New Creation
sections.description: Salvation is described as a new creation—God makes all things new.
